key_insight: High-fidelity CFD modeling reveals complex flow dynamics in pressurized water reactors that can be effectively predicted using machine learning techniques.
engineering_relevance: Understanding flow behavior in PWRs is essential for safety and efficiency in nuclear engineering applications.
method: Constructed a full lower-plenum and core-inlet domain using CFD simulations.
Implemented machine learning approaches for flow reconstruction and prediction.
Utilized a 3D convolutional inpainting model to address missing data in flow rates.
evidence_signal: Spatially aware ML models, particularly ConvLSTM, significantly improve prediction accuracy over traditional LSTM methods.
watch_item: The sensitivity of predictions to turbulence and mesh resolution remains a concern due to the lack of full-scale experimental validation data.
paper_title: High-fidelity Modeling of Full-scale Pressurized Water Reactor Flow Fields for Machine Learning Applications
